version.description: Version window claims are filtered against.

storageKey.description:
Key used to namespace dismissal state in the storage adapter. Defaults
to `'cinder-guidance'`—regions sharing one storage adapter without an
explicit `storageKey` collide in that namespace.

unsupportedProps.name: anchorResolver
unsupportedProps.description: Resolves a claim anchor using consumer-owned DOM knowledge.

unsupportedProps.name: children
unsupportedProps.description: Descendant application surface that consumes guidance through `useGuidance`.

unsupportedProps.name: claims
unsupportedProps.description:
Registered guidance claims available to descendants through
`useGuidance`. Defaults to `[]`.

unsupportedProps.name: storage
unsupportedProps.description: Adapter used to persist which claims a user has dismissed, so dismissal survives a reload.
